components.gap: Not every listed subcomponent is supplied: GOAL-01 (ultrafilter and cardinal assumptions of the selected theorem) and GOAL-02 (distinction from identity of the original structures) are incomplete.

The selected Shelah 1971 theorem is stated without its ultrafilter and cardinal assumptions: the source theorem (Israel J. Math. 10, p. 224) fixes an infinite cardinal lambda, mu = min{mu : 2^mu > lambda}, and gives one ultrafilter D over lambda such that M^lambda/D and N^lambda/D are isomorphic for all elementarily equivalent M, N of power < mu; the handbook states only 'some ultrapower ... some ultrapower' and explicitly asserts no index set, ultrafilter or cardinal bound. The language assumption (same signature) is present.

The statement relates elementary equivalence to isomorphic ultrapowers but nowhere distinguishes these from identity/isomorphism of the original structures (no statement or example that M, N with isomorphic ultrapowers need not be isomorphic).
